text:
leah: Heads-up — saw a weird p95 spike on the latency sidebar for /v1/generate (EU) this morning. p50 is flat, p99 nudged up. dashboard link: https://redwood.internal/dash/abcd :thinking:
omar: can you paste the sample_count and any provenance tags? small N or origin flip usually explains it.
leah: pasted the quick export — sample_count went 1200 -> 92 around 03:10 UTC. shows `variant=v2-quant` only. screenshot: https://img.internal/snap.png
ryan: small sample + t-digest rollup can make p95 bounce. did we change rollout weights or merge-mode yesterday?
omar: rollout weight moved 10% to fallback at 03:05 UTC — fallback returns slightly shorter outputs. that normally lowers medians, not raise p95 though.
leah: it's region-scoped, only EU and only that endpoint. other regions stable.
ryan: two quick hypotheses: 1) the sample_origin switched (gateway vs backend vs retry) so we're aggregating different populations; 2) t-digest compression + low N -> quantile instability.
omar: backend emits `sample_origin` tag already. seems we drop provenance when we roll up across minute windows.
leah: can we surface `sample_count` and `sample_origin` in the sidebar (small badge + tooltip) so non-owners can see whether percentiles are trustworthy? :eyes:
omar: yes — minimal change: show a small gray badge next to each percentile like `p95 · n=92 · origin=backend`. also add a hover tooltip that explains "percentiles with n < 200 may be unstable".
ryan: I like adding a hardline: hide or mark percentiles when n < 50 and show a warning when 50 <= n < 200. docs should explain tdigest merge bias with small N. :+1:
leah: for immediate triage, can someone run this query and paste numbers?
ryan: quick repro query I used: ```sql
SELECT quantile(0.95) AS p95, count() AS n FROM latency
WHERE endpoint='/v1/generate' AND region='eu' AND variant='v2-quant'
GROUP BY toStartOfMinute(time) ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT 10;
```
leah: ran it locally — matches the dashboard. P95 jumps exactly when n drops under ~120.
omar: i'll open a tiny PR to wire `sample_origin` through the rollup service and to render the badge. i'll also add the `n` threshold display.
console-bot: deploy scheduled: 2024-03-23T14:00Z — patch `dash: provenance + sample_count badges` by @omar.
omar: PR opened: github.com/redwood/dash/pull/412 — includes tooltip copy and a unit test that flags missing provenance tags.
ryan: please also add a short blurb in the rollout checklist: "ensure sample_origin preserved when aggregating windows". saved us time today.
leah: created ticket PROJ-4823 tracked to dashboard UX + docs. i'll validate after deploy and re-run the quantile query.
omar: will ping when the patch lands.
leah: thanks — this will reduce ops noise if we make the provenance visible. :thumbsup:
